checkpoint.provenance: reported by the live container at hook install: dim=2048, total_layers=40

gate.threshold_rule_meaning: The lowest threshold whose CatQA leak stays at or below 40. This rule is set AGAINST an evaluation corpus, so this kit's 17.1% CatQA leak is the constraint that was imposed, NOT a measurement of generalisation. It is not comparable to the gemma4 kit's 9.8%, which came from R3 and never saw CatQA.
gate.r3_alternative: R3 at this same layer gives 621/675 CySec at 30/234 CatQA. That is the point that would be directly comparable to the gemma4 kit.

method.name: M1_subcat_Tridge_lam16
method.summary: Closed-form, no gradient training. Eigendecomposition of the subcategory-centred scatter (divisor 225 = 100 + 140 - 1 - 14), ridge-whitened mean difference with alpha = lambda[15]. 240 forward passes total.

corpus.not_redistributed: The 240 fit prompts are NOT in this kit; only the handful quoted in canaries.json are. The md5s above identify them so a re-fit can be shown to have used the same corpus.
corpus.overlap_with_evaluation_corpora: zero, checked by key against all 11 evaluation corpora

fit.refit_note: Re-fit on the served checkpoint's own activations. The previously shipped ops/qwen36_L16_M1.json direction cleared its own threshold on 18 of its own 100 fitted training positives on this checkpoint -- the failure the kit binding check and the canaries exist to catch.

measured_live.basis: live harvest on the served checkpoint under this operator, raw threshold crossings

decomposition.note: The rescue contributes nothing on this kit, unlike gemma4 where it supplies 82.

measured_live.veto_exposure: 55 of the 651 recorded fires sit below the s_ref_z threshold of 1.50 and are removed by the two-factor veto, against 5 of 558 on gemma4.

known_gaps: The layer and the threshold were both selected against cysec_675 and catqa_234. Both are in-sample for that choice and there is no held-out confirmation.
The threshold is negative (-0.00022), so it sits in a dense part of the score distribution with very little margin either side.
wmdp_bio, sos_bio and wmdp_cyber have not been measured for this operator.
canaries.json carries positives only; see its known_gaps.

serve.reasoning_parser_note: Passed to vllm as --reasoning-parser. null means the model needs none.
